records.title: User Inventory
records.description: Regular and privileged users are identified and integrated into an inventory.
records.outcome: System owners have control of all authorized users.
records.impact: Users not on the authorized user list will be denied access by policy.

records.title: Conditional User Access
records.description: Creates a dynamic level of access for users through phased maturity.
records.outcome: Dynamic user, device, and NPE access through risk profiles.
records.impact: Unknown or high-risk users are denied access with greater accuracy.

records.title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
records.description: Centralize MFA and identity provider capabilities.
records.outcome: Users authenticate with at least two authentication factors.
records.impact: Users without multiple authentication forms are denied access.

records.title: Privileged Access Management (PAM)
records.description: Remove permanent administrator privileges through PAM.
records.outcome: Privileged identities are controlled, monitored, secured, and audited.
records.impact: Critical assets are secured through limits on admin access.

records.title: Identity Federation and User Credentialing
records.description: Standardize ILM and integrate with organizational IDP/IDM.
records.outcome: Credentials are issued, managed, and revoked across trust domains.
records.impact: Users lacking sufficient credentials are denied access.

records.title: Behavioral, Contextual ID, and Biometrics
records.description: Enable UEBA with enterprise and organizational attributes.
records.outcome: Behavioral, contextual, and biometric telemetry enhance access controls.

records.title: Least Privileged Access
records.description: Enforce least privilege across enterprise access.
records.outcome: Access is limited to minimum necessary privileges.
records.impact: Excessive privileges are removed or denied.

records.title: Continuous Authentication
records.description: Continuously evaluate authentication context during sessions.
records.outcome: Sessions are continuously evaluated for risk.
records.impact: High-risk sessions are terminated or re-authenticated.

records.title: Integrated ICAM Platform
records.description: Integrate ICAM capabilities across the enterprise.
